cnTitle: 紫微斗数二七同道：兄弟宫和迁移宫为什么是同一条路的两端
enTitle: Two-Seven Same Road in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Siblings and Travel Palaces Are Two Ends of One Path
enDesc: Counting Life as one, Siblings is two and Travel is seven. Two-Seven Same Road says peer relationships and where you go are one system: siblings, classmates, colleagues, partners and the outer environment jointly decide whether anyone catches you when you step out.
cnDesc: 以命宫为一逆数，兄弟为二、迁移为七，二七同道讲的是平辈关系和你走到哪、遇到谁本是一体：手足、同学、同事、合伙人和外部环境，共同决定一个人在外有没有人接得住。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数三八为朋：夫妻宫和交友宫为什么讲的是同一种缘分
enTitle: Three-Eight as Companions in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Spouse and Friends Palaces Describe the Same Kind of Bond
enDesc: Spouse is three and Friends is eight. Three-Eight as Companions says intimate bonds and your friend circle share one source: who attracts you and who you finally settle with is largely set by the crowd you normally move in.
cnDesc: 夫妻为三、交友为八，三八为朋说的是亲密关系和朋友圈层同源：你会被什么样的人吸引、最终和谁走到一起，很大程度由你平时混在什么样的人际圈里决定。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数四九为友：子女宫和官禄宫为什么共同决定你的「作品」
enTitle: Four-Nine as Allies in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Children and Career Palaces Jointly Shape Your "Works"
enDesc: Children is four and Career is nine. Four-Nine as Allies says children, subordinates, students, creative works and the career are one line: whether you can develop people, produce results and have concrete works carry your career requires reading both.
cnDesc: 子女为四、官禄为九，四九为友说的是子女、下属、学生、作品和事业本是一条线：你能不能带出人、做出成果、让事业被具体作品承接，要这两宫一起看。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数五十同途：财帛宫和田宅宫为什么必须合起来看钱
enTitle: Five-Ten Same Route in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Wealth and Property Palaces Must Be Read Together for Money
enDesc: Wealth is five and Property is ten. Five-Ten Same Route says cash flow and asset stock are one thing: Wealth is how money moves in and out, Property is what it finally becomes and whether it stays. Wealth judgment needs both.
cnDesc: 财帛为五、田宅为十，五十同途讲的是现金流和资产存量本是一体：财帛写钱怎么进怎么出，田宅写钱最后变成什么、留不留得住，断财富必须两宫同看。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天罗地网是什么：星落辰戌宫就一定差吗
enTitle: The Net of Heaven and Earth in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Are Stars in Chen and Xu Always Bad
enDesc: Chen is the Net of Heaven and Xu the Net of Earth; stars here often feel bound and unable to express. Yet the net is not a malefic—it is more like an enclosed period for settling and breaking out, and when used well it becomes a late-bloomer structure.
cnDesc: 辰为天罗、戌为地网，星曜落在这两宫常显得被捆住、施展不开，但天罗地网不是凶煞，它更像一段需要沉淀和突围的封闭期，用得好反而是大器晚成的结构。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数早晚子时怎么排：夜子时出生到底算今天还是明天
enTitle: Early and Late Zi Hour in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Does a Late-Night Birth Count as Today or Tomorrow
enDesc: The Zi hour spans 23:00–01:00 across midnight. Whether a late-Zi birth (23:00–24:00) changes the day pillar and how the Life Palace is placed differs among schools; understanding this dispute is how you cast reliably at the hour boundary.
cnDesc: 子时跨午夜二十三点到一点，晚子时（23:00–24:00）出生的人日柱要不要换天、命宫怎么安，各派处理不同；理解早晚子时之争，才能在时辰交界时排出可靠的盘。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数排盘为什么要校正真太阳时：出生地经度差一点，时辰可能差一格
enTitle: Why Zi Wei Dou Shu Charts Need Apparent Solar Time Correction: Longitude Can Shift Your Hour Block
enDesc: Clocks use unified Beijing time, but casting uses the apparent solar time at the birthplace. Every 15 degrees of longitude is about an hour, and with daylight saving and the equation of time, a boundary-hour birth can land in the wrong palace without correction.
cnDesc: 钟表用的是统一的北京时间，排盘却要用出生地当时的真太阳时；经度每偏15度约差一小时，再加上夏令时和均时差，时辰交界出生的人不校正就可能排错宫位。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数身宫落在哪怎么看：六个落点对应六种后天发力方向
enTitle: Where Your Body Palace Lands in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Six Attachments, Six Acquired Directions
enDesc: The Body Palace attaches to only one of six palaces—Life, Spouse, Wealth, Travel, Career or Karma. Wherever it lands, that is where midlife increasingly invests energy and finds achievement; it describes your acquired, self-driven direction.
cnDesc: 身宫只寄于命、夫妻、财帛、迁移、官禄、福德六宫之一，落在哪个宫，人到中年后就越把精力和成就感押在哪件事上，它写的是你后天主动发力的方向。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数安星法总览：一张盘是按什么顺序一步步排出来的
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu Star Placement Overview: The Sequence That Builds a Chart Step by Step
enDesc: A chart is not an app black box but a fixed layering: set the twelve palaces, place Zi Wei and the fourteen major stars, then assistants and malefics, then the Four Transformations, then minor and annual stars. Understanding this sequence lets you read a chart and catch app errors.
cnDesc: 排盘不是软件一键黑箱，而是按定十二宫、安紫微与十四主星、安辅煞、安四化、安杂曜流曜的固定顺序逐层布出来的；理解这套顺序，你才看得懂盘、也能发现软件排错。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数流年四化怎么取：今年的禄权科忌从哪来、怎么叠
enTitle: How to Derive Annual Four Transformations in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Where This Year's Lu-Quan-Ke-Ji Come From and How to Layer Them
enDesc: Annual transformations follow the year stem; as the stem changes, Lu/Quan/Ke/Ji land on different stars. It is not a separate chart but the current-year fuse layered over natal and decade transformations—all three must be read together.
cnDesc: 流年四化按当年天干取，天干一变，化禄化权化科化忌落在不同星上；它不是另一张盘，而是叠在本命、大限之上的「当年引信」，三层四化合看才断得准。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数飞化对待：两个宫互相化禄化忌，关系才看得透
enTitle: Mutual Transformation in Zi Wei Dou Shu: When Two Palaces Transform Into Each Other, a Relationship Becomes Clear
enDesc: One palace flying outward shows only a one-way flow; a real relationship needs mutuality: A sends Lu into B while B sends Ji back to A. The round trip reveals who gives, who owes and who holds whom—essential for love, partnership and work.
cnDesc: 单看一个宫飞化出去只看到单向付出，真正的关系要看「对待」：A宫化禄入B、B宫化忌回A，一来一回才知道谁给、谁欠、谁牵制谁，婚恋合伙职场都靠这套断。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数气数位是什么：官禄的官禄，为什么能看一件事能撑多久
enTitle: What Is the Qi-Number Position in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Career-of-Career and Why It Shows How Long Something Lasts
enDesc: A palace's qi-number position is nine steps from it (its own Career position) and reads that matter's staying power and resilience. The home palace shows the present; the qi-number shows staying power—a strong home with a hollow qi-number often shines briefly but cannot last.
cnDesc: 一宫的气数位，是从本宫数到第九位（即它的官禄位），专门看这件事的「续航力与抗风险能力」；本宫写现状，气数位写后劲，本宫好而气数位虚，往往风光一时却撑不长。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数博士十二神是什么：从禄存起的十二颗流年辅神
enTitle: The Twelve Doctor Spirits in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Twelve Annual Helpers Starting From Lu Cun
enDesc: The twelve Doctor spirits start at Lu Cun and proceed clockwise for yang-male/yin-female or counterclockwise for yin-male/yang-female: Doctor, Strength, Green Dragon, Small Loss, General, Memorial, Flying, Joy, Illness, Great Loss, Ambush and Official. They never lead a verdict; they add or subtract on the major-star structure and hint at timing.
cnDesc: 博士十二神从禄存所在宫起，按阳男阴女顺、阴男阳女逆，依次安博士、力士、青龙、小耗、将军、奏书、飞廉、喜神、病符、大耗、伏兵、官府；它们不主导吉凶，只在主星结构上做加减分和应期提示。

cnTitle: 博士十二神在流年怎么用：青龙进财、奏书中榜、伏兵暗耗的应期
enTitle: Using the Twelve Doctor Spirits in Annual Reading: Green Dragon's Income, Memorial's Documents, Ambush's Hidden Drain
enDesc: The Doctors earn their keep mainly in the annual and minor-limit reading: as the year's palace reaches a spirit, combined with that palace's stars and transformations it hints where the year brings joy, document-based opportunity, or hidden drain and paperwork—a timing aid.
cnDesc: 博士十二神的价值主要在流年和小限：当流年宫位走到某颗辅神，结合该宫主星四化，能提示这一年哪里有喜、哪里有文书机会、哪里要防暗耗与手续麻烦，是定应期的辅助工具。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数长生十二神是什么：从五行局起的人生十二阶段
enTitle: The Twelve Life-Cycle Spirits in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Twelve Life Stages Starting From the Five-Element Phase
enDesc: The twelve Life-Cycle spirits start from the Five-Element phase (Metal at Si, Wood at Hai, Water at Shen, Fire/Earth at Yin), proceeding clockwise for yang-male/yin-female and counterclockwise otherwise: Birth, Bath, Capping, Official, Emperor, Decline, Illness, Death, Grave, Extinction, Embryo, Nurture. They describe how a matter's qi rises, peaks and recedes.
cnDesc: 长生十二神按五行局定长生起点（金长生在巳、木在亥、水在申、火土在寅），阳男阴女顺、阴男阳女逆，依次布长生、沐浴、冠带、临官、帝旺、衰、病、死、墓、绝、胎、养，用来描述一件事从生发、鼎盛到收敛的气数强弱。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数长生十二神落宫怎么用：命坐长生帝旺和坐死绝的差别
enTitle: How to Use the Life-Cycle Spirits by Palace: Birth/Emperor vs Death/Extinction in the Life Palace
enDesc: The same major star on rising stages (Birth, Official, Emperor) versus falling ones (Decline, Illness, Death, Extinction) shows visibly different drive and pace. The spirits label each palace's matter with a life-cycle position—a second ruler alongside brightness.
cnDesc: 同一颗主星落在长生、临官、帝旺这类上升阶段，和落在衰病死绝这类下降阶段，外显的劲头和处事节奏明显不同；长生十二神落宫用来给十二宫所主的事标定「生命周期位置」，是庙旺之外的第二把尺子。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数将前十二星是什么：看助力与暗耗的另一组本命辅神
enTitle: The Twelve Pre-General Stars in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Another Set of Natal Helpers for Support and Hidden Drain
enDesc: The twelve Pre-General stars are placed by the birth-year branch: General, Saddle, Year-Stage, Rest, Canopy, Robbery, Disaster, Heaven-Sha, Back-Point,咸池 (Bath/Pool), Month-Sha and Perishing-Spirit. General/Saddle/Stage lean supportive while Robbery/Disaster/Perishing lean turbulent—again auxiliary, never leading.
cnDesc: 将前十二星依生年地支安，包括将星、攀鞍、岁驿、息神、华盖、劫煞、灾煞、天煞、指背、咸池、月煞、亡神；其中将星攀鞍岁驿偏助力，劫煞灾煞亡神等偏波折，同样只作辅看，不主导命盘。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数岁前十二神是什么：从流年太岁起的一年吉凶注脚
enTitle: The Twelve Pre-Year Spirits in Zi Wei Dou Shu: A Year's Footnotes Starting From the Annual Grand-Duke
enDesc: The twelve Pre-Year spirits start at the annual branch (the Grand-Duke palace) as Year-Builder and proceed clockwise: Year-Builder, Gloom, Mourning, Coil, Official, Small Loss, Great Loss, Virtue-Dragon, White Tiger, Heavenly Virtue, Guest-Hanging and Illness. They rotate yearly to mark each palace's joy, blockage and friction as an annual auxiliary layer.
cnDesc: 岁前十二神以流年地支（太岁所在宫）起岁建，顺行十二宫，依次为岁建、晦气、丧门、贯索、官符、小耗、大耗、龙德、白虎、天德、吊客、病符；它们一年一换，专门标注这一年各宫的喜庆、阻滞与是非，是流年的辅助层。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天干系流曜：流禄流羊流陀流昌流曲怎么安怎么用
enTitle: Stem-Based Flowing Stars in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How to Place and Use Flowing Lu, Yang, Tuo, Chang and Qu
enDesc: A set of flowing stars placed by the year (also decade or month) stem—Flowing Lu, Qing Yang, Tuo Luo, Kui, Yue, Wen Chang, Wen Qu and the annual transformations—is a temporary annual layer over natal assistants, showing where the year's resources, tests and document chances land.
cnDesc: 按流年（也可大限、流月）天干安的一组流曜——流禄、流擎羊、流陀罗、流天魁、流天钺、流文昌、流文曲和流年四化，是叠在本命辅星上的「当年临时层」，主这一年资源、考验与文书机会落在哪。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数地支系流曜：流魁流钺流鸾流喜流马怎么看姻缘与变动
enTitle: Branch-Based Flowing Stars in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Flowing Kui-Yue, Luan-Xi and Horse for Romance and Movement
enDesc: A set placed by the year branch—Flowing Kui, Yue, Hong Luan, Tian Xi and Tian Ma (plus the Pre-Year spirits)—shows where this year's helpful people, romance/celebrations and movement land. It complements the stem set: one for resources/tests, the other for patrons, joy and travel.
cnDesc: 按流年地支安的一组流曜——流天魁、流天钺、流红鸾、流天喜、流天马（以及岁前十二神），主这一年贵人、姻缘喜事和迁动出差落在哪；它和天干系流曜互补，一个看资源考验，一个看贵人喜事与走动。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数铃贪格：贪狼遇铃星，闷烧式横发和火贪差在哪
enTitle: The Ling-Tan Pattern in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Tan Lang Meets Ling Xing—Slow-Burn Windfall vs the Huo-Tan Pattern
enDesc: Ling-Tan forms when Tan Lang shares a palace (or meets by trine) Ling Xing. Along with Huo-Tan it is a "Tan Lang meets Fire" windfall structure, but Ling Xing is yin fire—brewing and reserved—so the windfall comes slower, runs deeper and tests whether you can hold it.
cnDesc: 铃贪格是贪狼与铃星同宫（或三方会照）成格，和火贪格同属「贪狼遇火铃」的横发结构，但铃星是阴火、主酝酿与城府，横发来得慢、藏得深，也更考验一个人能不能守得住。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数巨逢四煞是什么：巨门再会四煞，口舌是非为什么被放大
enTitle: Ju Men Meets Four Malefics in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Gossip and Dispute Get Amplified When Ju Men Meets the Malefics
enDesc: Ju Men is the star of speech and obscurity, governing dispute, suspicion and expression. When it also meets Qing Yang, Tuo Luo, Huo Xing and Ling Xing in the palace or by clashing trine, it forms Ju-Men-Meets-Four-Malefics—dispute, legal trouble,奔波 and hidden drain; yet when exalted with Lu or Hua Ke it can instead become "wealth through speech."
cnDesc: 巨门本是口舌、暗曜之星，主是非、猜疑与表达，若再与擎羊、陀罗、火星、铃星四煞同宫或三方冲会，就成巨逢四煞，主口舌官非、奔波波折与身心暗耗；但庙旺得禄、化科反可成「以口生财」的另一番格局。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数双禄交流、叠禄是什么：禄存和化禄交会为什么主稳财
enTitle: Double-Lu Exchange and Stacked Lu in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Lu Cun Meeting Hua Lu Signals Stable Wealth
enDesc: Lu Cun and Hua Lu in one palace is Stacked Lu; mutual Hua Lu between palaces or Lu Cun meeting Hua Lu by trine is Double-Lu Exchange. Both signal steady income, multiple earning channels and resilience. Lu Cun leans stable and conservative, Hua Lu to opportunity and growth, so their overlap is a wealth pattern with both source and expansion.
cnDesc: 禄存与化禄同宫称叠禄、两宫化禄互入或禄存化禄三方交会称双禄交流，都主财源稳、进财渠道多、抗风险能力强；区别在于禄存偏稳定守成、化禄偏机会增长，两者叠加是「既有源头又能增长」的财格。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数流年天干地支各管什么：一个定四化流曜，一个定流年命宫
enTitle: What the Year Stem and Branch Each Govern in Zi Wei Dou Shu: One Sets Transformations, the Other Sets the Year Life Palace
enDesc: In an annual reading, separate the stem and branch: the year stem decides that year's transformations and stem-based flowing stars (Flowing Lu, Chang/Qu, etc.), while the year branch decides where the year Life Palace (Grand-Duke) sits plus Flowing Luan/Xi/Ma and the Pre-Year spirits. Each governs its own side; together they make the full annual chart.
cnDesc: 看流年要把天干和地支分开用：流年天干决定这一年的四化和流禄流昌曲等天干系流曜，流年地支决定流年命宫（太岁）落在哪以及流鸾流喜流马、岁前十二神，两者各管一摊，合起来才是完整的流年盘。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数伏吟反吟是什么：流年走到和本命相同、相冲的宫会怎样
enTitle: Fu-Yin and Fan-Yin in Zi Wei Dou Shu: What Happens When the Year Repeats or Clashes the Natal Palace
enDesc: When a year (or decade) reaches a palace with the same stem-branch as a natal palace it is Fu-Yin—repetition, stagnation, old matters returning; reaching the branch-clashed opposite line is Fan-Yin—turbulence, reversal and external impact. They are not omens but two different tempo signals.
cnDesc: 当流年（或大限）走到与本命某宫干支相同的宫，叫伏吟，主重复、停滞、旧事重来；走到地支相冲的对宫一线，叫反吟，主动荡、反复、外部冲击。它们不是凶兆，而是两种不同的节奏提示。

cnTitle: 本命、大限、流年吉凶怎么叠：三层好坏的八种组合一次讲清
enTitle: How Natal, Decade and Year Luck Stack: The Eight Good-Bad Combinations of Three Layers Explained
enDesc: The natal chart is the baseline, the decade the ten-year stage, the year the trigger; each leans good or bad, giving exactly eight combinations. Sorting your matter into one of the eight tells whether this year is for pushing, holding, lying low or defending hard.
cnDesc: 本命是底色、大限是十年阶段、流年是当年触发，每层都有偏吉或偏凶，二的三次方正好八种组合；把你关心的事归到这八种之一，就知道今年是趁势、守成、蛰伏还是要特别防守。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看考研读博深造：父母宫文书、官禄星和化科怎么配合
enTitle: Reading Graduate School and Academic Advancement in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How the Parents Palace (Documents), Career Stars and Hua Ke Work Together
enDesc: Exams test current ability, but academic advancement reads longer-term scholarly aptitude and credential luck: combine Career (professional path), Parents (documents, advisors, admission), Wen Chang/Wen Qu and Hua Ke (learning and reputation), then use decade and year to time the breakthrough.
cnDesc: 考试看实力，深造看的是更长线的学术禀赋与文凭运，要把官禄宫（专业路线）、父母宫（文书、导师、录取认证）、文昌文曲与化科（学问名声）合起来看，再用大限流年定上岸年份。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看求职面试：为什么offer要重点看父母宫
enTitle: Reading Job Hunting and Interviews in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why the Offer Points to the Parents Palace
enDesc: Career shows what you do and your ability, while interviews, offers, background checks and contracts—credentials an institution or superior issues you—mainly read the Parents palace. Job hunting uses Career for role fit, Parents for interview and hiring flow, and the year for timing.
cnDesc: 官禄宫看你做什么、能力如何，而面试、offer、背调、合同这类「由上级和机构发给你的认证文书」主要看父母宫；求职要官禄定岗位匹配、父母宫定面试与录用顺不顺，流年定时间窗。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看向上管理：官禄、父母、交友三宫决定你和领导的关系
enTitle: Managing Up in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How Career, Parents and Friends Palaces Shape Your Relationship With Leadership
enDesc: Day-to-day with your direct manager reads Career; higher/cross-level leaders and formal approvals read Parents; peer collaboration and cross-team reputation read Friends. Managing up is not flattery but seeing where each of these three layers sticks and which communication style works.
cnDesc: 和直属上级的日常关系看官禄宫，和更高层、跨级领导及正式文书批复看父母宫，平级协作与跨部门口碑看交友宫；向上管理不是讨好，而是看清这三层关系分别卡在哪、用什么方式沟通最有效。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看你的理财风格：财帛、田宅、福德定风险偏好
enTitle: Your Money-Management Style in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Wealth, Property and Karma Palaces Set Your Risk Appetite
enDesc: How someone manages money and tolerates volatility reads Wealth (earning/spending), Property (whether it settles into assets) and Karma (psychological tolerance of gains/losses), plus the financial nature of stars like Wu Qu, Tian Fu, Tai Yin and Tan Lang. Matching your own profile beats copying someone else's allocation.
cnDesc: 一个人怎么理财、能承受多大波动，要看财帛宫（赚钱与花钱方式）、田宅宫（能不能沉淀成资产）、福德宫（对盈亏的心理承受），再结合武曲、天府、太阴、贪狼等主星的财性，对号入座比盲目抄别人的配置有效得多。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看保险和应急钱：哪些盘更需要先把安全垫垫厚
enTitle: Insurance and Emergency Money in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Which Charts Need a Thicker Safety Cushion First
enDesc: Insurance and reserves map to the chart's risk defenses: Health for health risk, Property for the household cushion, Wealth for cash-flow resilience, Travel/Friends for accidents and external liability. Certain combinations face sudden expenses more often and should build insurance and emergency money before investing.
cnDesc: 保险和应急储备对应盘里的「风险防线」：疾厄宫看健康风险、田宅宫看家庭安全垫、财帛看现金流韧性、迁移与交友看意外和外部连带；特定组合偏容易遇到突发支出，更要先把保险和应急钱配好，再谈投资。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看职场被边缘化：官禄、交友、父母三宫找原因和解法
enTitle: Workplace Marginalization in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Finding Causes and Ways Out Through Career, Friends and Parents
enDesc: Being sidelined has three layers: Career for whether the role itself is weakened, Friends for peer relations and isolation/credit-taking, Parents for whether superiors still recognize you. Telling structural change from interpersonal exclusion from a communication problem leads to totally different solutions.
cnDesc: 被边缘化要分三层看：官禄宫看岗位本身是否被削弱，交友宫看平级关系和有没有人孤立抢功，父母宫看上级是否还认可你；分清是岗位结构性调整、人际排挤，还是自己沟通方式的问题，解法完全不同。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数怎么选行业：星曜五行和行业属性对上，做起来更顺
enTitle: How to Choose an Industry in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Aligning Star Five-Element Nature With Industry Attributes Makes Work Flow
enDesc: Beyond Career strength, industry choice can align a major star's five-element temperament with an industry's nature: Fire for optics/energy/food/internet, Water for logistics/trade/travel/media, Wood for education/culture/publishing/medicine, Metal for finance/machinery/law, Earth for real estate/construction/agriculture/storage—working with your nature reduces friction.
cnDesc: 选行业除了看官禄宫强弱，还可以把主星的五行气质和行业的五行属性对齐：火性主光电能源餐饮互联网，水性主物流贸易旅游传播，木性主教育文化出版医药，金性主金融机械法律，土性主房地产建筑农业仓储，顺性而为阻力更小。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看婆媳关系：父母宫、夫妻宫、田宅宫怎么一起断
enTitle: Reading In-Law Dynamics in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Combining Parents, Spouse and Property Palaces
enDesc: In-law dynamics are not read from Spouse alone but three layers: Spouse for whether the partner mediates, Parents for the elders' temperament and boundaries, Property for the household atmosphere under one roof. Together they show whether friction comes from an absent partner, elder interference or living structure.
cnDesc: 婆媳关系不是只看夫妻宫，要看三层：夫妻宫看伴侣会不会居中调和，父母宫看双方长辈的性格与边界，田宅宫看同住一个屋檐下的家庭气场；三层合看才知道矛盾出在伴侣缺位、长辈干涉还是居住结构。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看单恋暗恋：命宫、夫妻、交友怎么判断有没有结果
enTitle: Reading One-Sided and Secret Crushes in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How Life, Spouse and Friends Palaces Hint at an Outcome
enDesc: A crush is a one-way bond: Life/Karma show your projection and needs in love, Spouse the type you truly fit, Friends whether a real channel of contact exists. Together they distinguish a bond worth pursuing from a projection living only in your imagination.
cnDesc: 单恋暗恋看的是「单向的缘」：命宫和福德看你在感情里的投射与需求，夫妻宫看你真正适配什么类型，交友宫看两个人现实中有没有交集的通道；三宫合看，能区分这是值得推进的缘分，还是只存在于你想象里的投射。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看婚姻倦怠期：哪些盘、哪些大限容易进入平淡期，怎么修
enTitle: Marriage Burnout in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Which Charts and Decades Slip Into Staleness, and How to Repair
enDesc: Marriage burnout is not the end of a bond; it is usually activated in a specific decade when Spouse or Karma is touched by Ji or malefics, bringing less communication and cooled feeling. Distinguish phase fatigue, structural problems and outside冲击 to know whether to repair, adjust or let go.
cnDesc: 婚姻倦怠不等于缘分尽了，它通常在特定大限被引动：夫妻宫或福德宫被化忌、煞星引动时易出现沟通减少、情感降温；分清是阶段性疲惫、结构性问题还是外缘冲击，才知道该修复、该调整还是该放手。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看脱单：什么时候桃花到位、往哪个方向主动最有效
enTitle: Leaving Single Life in Zi Wei Dou Shu: When Romance Arrives and Where to Be Proactive
enDesc: Leaving single life uses Spouse for the fitting type, Karma for what you need in a bond, Friends/Travel for the channels of meeting, and decade/year Hong Luan/Tian Xi, Hua Lu and flowing Luan/Xi for the timing window. The chart indicates when, in what settings and how you most easily meet the right person.
cnDesc: 脱单要看夫妻宫定适配类型、福德宫定你在关系里要什么、交友宫和迁移宫定遇见人的通道，再用大限流年的红鸾天喜、化禄和流鸾流喜定时间窗；盘上能指出「什么时候、在哪类场合、用什么方式」最容易遇到对的人。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数排盘需要哪些信息：只知道大概生辰怎么办
enTitle: What Information Zi Wei Dou Shu Casting Needs: What to Do With Only an Approximate Birth Time
enDesc: Accurate casting needs the solar or lunar birth date and time, birthplace (for apparent solar time) and gender. If the hour is uncertain, lay out candidate charts and reverse-verify against past events, checking the few possible hours one by one rather than picking one at random.
cnDesc: 准确排盘需要公历或农历的出生年月日时、出生地点（用于真太阳时）和性别；若时辰记不清，可用多盘并列、以过往大事反推定盘，把可能的两三个时辰逐一核对，而不是随便选一个就开始断。

cnTitle: 零基础怎么自学紫微斗数：一条不绕路的学习顺序与避坑
enTitle: How to Learn Zi Wei Dou Shu From Zero: A Step-by-Step Path and Pitfalls to Avoid
enDesc: The biggest self-study mistake is memorizing a hundred stars and rushing verdicts. The right order is twelve palaces and casting skeleton first, then the fourteen major stars, triple-direction and transformations, then assistants/patterns, and only finally decade/year and practice—building layer by layer beats scattered learning.
cnDesc: 自学最怕一上来背一百多颗星、急着断吉凶。正确顺序是先懂十二宫和排盘骨架，再学十四主星，接着三方四正和四化，然后辅煞与格局，最后才是大限流年和实战，一层层搭，比东一榔头西一棒子快得多。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数和八字有什么区别：一个看宫位事件，一个看五行气机
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu vs BaZi: One Reads Palaces and Events, the Other Five-Element Qi
enDesc: Zi Wei Dou Shu frames stars landing in palaces and excels at concrete people, palaces and events with vivid, accessible pictures; BaZi frames stem-branch five-element generation/control and excels at overall qi, structural level and annual fortune. Neither replaces the other—they are different lenses, often combined to cross-check.
cnDesc: 紫微斗数以星曜落宫为骨架，擅长具体到人事、宫位和事件层面，画面感强、好上手；八字以天干地支五行生克为骨架，擅长看整体气机、格局层次与流年气运；两者不是谁替代谁，而是视角不同，很多人会合参互证。
